obligations.note: The head copy of integrations.py lists payment-advice at https://advice.fernbrook.example/v1, and the other three endpoints are also https. The registered exhaustive test tests/controls/test_integrations_control.py::test_integrations_use_tls ran and is not among the failures.

payment-advice is in the inventory, but owner is an empty string, so it has no owner. The exhaustive control test test_integrations_are_inventoried fails with ('payment-advice', 'no owner'), and test_inventory_entries_have_owner_and_classification fails on that empty owner.

The change names CHG-26889, which Grace Kim (change manager) approved on 2026-10-16 before review. Its components are payments.integrations and payments.controls-data, which cover integrations.py and controls/payments/asset-inventory.json.
Sofia Santos approved a code_review on the head commit. She has the change_approver role for payments and is not the author, Mara Costa.
The change is a single commit, 9e5d3b77a6f65180d78a29e0b7fa29b5f55f6559, and the code review, security review, and control-owner approvals all name that commit.

records/ci/run.json records a failure of ci/run-tests.sh baseline-payments on the final commit. The JUnit report has 172 tests and 2 failures, including the registered INV-1 control test, which is unskipped but not passing.
integrations.py is in the security-sensitive payments.integrations component. Kofi Mensah, a security_reviewer and not the author, approved a security_review of the head commit.
asset-inventory.json is under the protected controls/ paths. Bao Tran, a control_owner on the controls-office team, not payments-eng, approved that same head commit.
Ticket CHG-26889 is type standard and the change record sets emergency to false, so a post-implementation review is not required.
The change does not rely on an exception. EXC-0141 is expired and scoped to SES-1, EXC-0167 is for mortgage logging, and EXC-0172 is withdrawn, so none excuses the missing payment-advice owner.
The diff changes only integrations.py and asset-inventory.json. Ledger evidence covers payments, audit, routes, and mortgage underwriting and approvals, none of which this change alters.

summary: The change registers a payment-advice HTTPS endpoint and adds a matching inventory row, but that row has an empty owner. INV-1 requires every outbound integration to be inventoried with an owner and a data classification, and the exhaustive inventory control test fails on payment-advice for lack of an owner. The payments suite on the final commit also fails, so CHG-4 is not met. The ticket, independent code review, security review, and control-owner approval are in order, and the TLS obligation is met, but the missing owner and the failing suite require rejection.
